decisions.statement: The public beta will launch on November 15.
decisions.source_quote: Shrey Vohra (You):  We have decided the public beta launches on November 15. That gives us 4 weeks.

decisions.statement: Use Shripe as the payments provider.
decisions.source_quote: Shrey Vohra (You):  Agreed. Next, payments. We'll go with Shripe for payments; I've used it before, the docs are clean and setup is fast.

decisions.statement: The monthly plan will cost 1500 rupees and include lunch and dinner.
decisions.source_quote: Shrey Vohra (You):  Pricing: the monthly plan will be 1500, so 1500 rupees a month, with lunch and dinner included.

action_items.title: Finish the API spec
action_items.source_quote: Pragti:  Four weeks is tight but doable if the backend scope stays small.

action_items.title: Finish the API set
action_items.source_quote: Pragti:  Okay. Then from my side, the API spec is the blocker for the everything else. I'll finish the API set by Friday, October 24.

action_items.title: Make the landing page live
action_items.source_quote: Shrey Vohra (You):  Perfect. I'll own the landing page and have it live by October 28.

action_items.source_quote: Shrey Vohra (You):  Rahul will design the onboarding screens by October 22. I'll tell him today.
